subject: general
question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

Rainforests are essential for biodiversity. P: Trees store carbon and release oxygen. Q: They are home to countless species. R: Yet, deforestation threatens these ecosystems. S: Some plants even hold potential medical cures. 6. So, preserving rainforests is a global concern.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given passage discusses the importance of rainforests and their role in biodiversity.
 
• **Sentence Q is the first**, as it introduces the rainforests and their role in housing countless species:
 
 
• "They are home to countless species."
 
 
 
• **Sentence R follows**, as it highlights the threat to these ecosystems:
 
 
• "Yet, deforestation threatens these ecosystems."
 
 
 
• **Sentence S comes next**, as it elaborates on the significance of plants found in rainforests:
 
 
• "Some plants even hold potential medical cures."
 
 
 
• **Sentence P concludes**, as it provides the broader environmental benefit of trees:
 
 
• "Trees store carbon and release oxygen."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **QRSP**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Rainforests are essential for biodiversity. They are home to countless species. Yet, deforestation threatens these ecosystems. Some plants even hold potential medical cures. Trees store carbon and release oxygen. So, preserving rainforests is a global concern."
